signIn.title: Choose a demo role card
signIn.intro: Kafa'a has no passwords in the demo. Pick a role card to see the portal as that person; opening a link never signs anyone in.
signIn.localBody: All 57 personas are available. Data is synthetic and stays in this browser.
signIn.liveBody: Kafa'a reuses your ENEC NEXUS role-card session. If a card does not sign in here, choose it in NEXUS first.
signIn.localOnlyError: This persona exists only in the local demo. Switch to local demo data to use it.

groupHelp.staff: The NEXUS role cards with elevated Kafa'a roles such as line manager, licensing coordinator or auditor.
